renderer: GL Compatibility using Mesa llvmpipe software rendering
method: Same western-path camera, 10 warmup frames, 60 measured process-frame intervals per version; no automated player movement. Single run each; V-Sync unsupported in this environment. Frame time includes all work, not separate CPU and GPU timings.

baseline.scope: 60 frames after 10 warmup at western path; not target hardware or GPU/CPU separation

optimized_decorated.scope: 60 frames after 10 warmup at western path; not target hardware or GPU/CPU separation

limitations: Software renderer and one viewpoint; this does not establish performance on user hardware, additional camera angles, or a frame-rate target.
